reuse.why: Reuses the shared category selector, amount conversion, budget writer, and undo wrappers, but implements tag recognition instead of using extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Category exclusions remain centralized, but the new #fixed regex duplicates tag-recognition logic already maintained in shared/tags.ts.

placement.why: Selection policy and budget calculations stay in server/budget/actions.ts, with method registration in server/budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: All month-wide consumers share the exclusion policy, although the separate tag parser introduces another definition maintainers must synchronize.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts uses a custom #fixed regex instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline #fixed regex reshapes existing shared tag extraction into a dedicated membership test rather than reusing the tag abstraction.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories replaces the existing includeHidden parameter; the new exclusions are shared policy, and every month-wide consumer continues through getBulkBudgetCategories.
